headline: RBI issues (Payment Banks - Know Your Customer) Amendment Directions, 2026
reference: Reserve Bank of India (Payment Banks - Know Your Customer) Amendment Directions, 2026
summary_points: RBI has published the Reserve Bank of India (Payment Banks - Know Your Customer) Amendment Directions, 2026 on its Notifications page.
The Directions amend the existing KYC framework applicable to Payment Banks.
The text available is only the web page shell; the provisions, dates and the nature of the amendments are not visible.
The full notification is available as a PDF (about 241 kb) on the RBI website.
who_is_affected: Payment Banks regulated by RBI, their compliance teams, and customers onboarded under the KYC norms for payment banks.
action_required: Read the full amendment directions on the RBI website, identify the changes and update KYC policies and onboarding procedures accordingly.

The Directions amend the KYC framework that applies to Payment Banks and have been published on the RBI Notifications page.

The specific amendments, issue date and effective date are not visible in the page text we reviewed, so we recommend reading the full PDF before drawing conclusions.

What to do now:
- Download and read the full Directions
- Map the changes against your current KYC policy and onboarding workflows
- Brief compliance, risk and operations teams on any revisions

Payment Banks, their advisers and auditors should track this closely, as KYC compliance is a frequent supervisory focus area.

Please verify the details with the official RBI source before acting.
